self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Bathhouses, Hawks, and Narukami (R1): Elemental Mastery +120 for 6s after triggering Swirl. Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

Bathhouses, Hawks, and Narukami (R1): Elemental Mastery +96 for 9s after the wielder's Elemental Skill hits an opponent. Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

Bathhouses, Hawks, and Narukami (R1): Elemental Mastery +32 for 30s after the wielder's Elemental Burst hits an opponent. Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: A bell lantern forged from purple jade. They say it brings sweet dreams when placed beside one's pillow.

refinements.1: Elemental Mastery increases by <r>120</r> for 6s after triggering Swirl or Stellar Swirl. Elemental Mastery increases by <r>96</r> for 9s after the wielder's Elemental Skill hits an opponent. Elemental Mastery increases by <r>32</r> for 30s after the wielder's Elemental Burst hits an opponent.

fr.flavor: Une lanterne en forme de cloche forgée à partir de jade violet. On dit qu'elle fait rêver lorsqu'elle est placée à côté de l'oreiller.
